Small dog breeds have captured the hearts of many as beloved pets. Their liveliness, charm and boundless energy are truly endearing. They adapt well to a sedentary lifestyle, even in urban settings, as long as they receive their regular dose of exercise. 

Now that your small breed has reached adulthood, it’s essential they have a size-specific tailored diet that provides the nutrients they need to help support optimal health during this stage of life. ROYAL CANIN® Mini Adult is a nutritionally complete and balanced formula specially designed to meet your small dog’s particular needs and support them throughout their adult years.  

This diet is for small dogs that weigh up to 10kg and are over 10 months old. Small dogs have remarkable energy levels and need a diet that caters to their spirited nature and active lifestyle, all while helping to maintain good bone health. ROYAL CANIN® Mini Adult is also available in a Morsels In Gravy wet food texture. Mixing wet and dry food brings variety to your dog’s diet, making their mealtimes more interesting and engaging. Dry kibble creates a mechanical brushing effect to help maintain dental health, while the moisture content in wet food helps to keep your dog hydrated and maintain their urinary health. 

All ROYAL CANIN® products go through an extensive quality control process to guarantee high-quality food, and they’re also packaged under a protective atmosphere to preserve freshness and nutritional quality for longer. Our team of scientists create formulas tailored to your dog’s specific nutritional needs, using high-quality nutrients and keeping sustainability in mind.
